 Mung beans recalled in 22 states after customers report glass fragments
 Prev

 Add Scripps News as a Google Preferred Source 
 A recall has been issued for a brand of mung beans due to the potential presence of glass.
 According to the FDA, Vitamin Cottage Natural Food Markets, Inc. is recalling its Natural Grocers Brand Organic 2-Pound Mung Beans after customers complained about sharp glass fragments in the product.
 RECENT RECALL |  WinCo Foods hoagie rolls recalled in 7 states over undeclared sesame 
 The company said the product may have been shipped to stores in the following states: Arkansas, Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Dakota, Texas, Utah, Washington, Wisconsin and Wyoming.
 The beans are packaged in 2-pound clear plastic bags with UPC 000080112600.
 SAFETY ALERT |  Safety warning issued for hundreds of thousands of pressure cookers nationwide 
 The recall includes the following pack dates: 26-160, 26-173, 26-196, 26-224 and 26-258. The pack date can be found in the lower-left corner of the label.
 If you purchased this product, you should stop using it immediately and either throw it away or return it for a full refund or credit. You can contact the company at 303-226-1434, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Mountain time, or email media@naturalgrocers.com.
